# Names that don't belong in this public repository, kept as hashes so this
# file doesn't spell them out. scripts/check-public-text.sh reads it beside
# denylist.txt. One per line: NAME:FLAGS:SHA256
#   NAME    the rule's id in the report
#   FLAGS   "i" hashes the word lowercased, "-" as written
#   SHA256  of the word, which is matched against each word of a line, and
#           against each run of up to 4 of its parts split at a "-" or a "."
# Print a line to add with: scripts/check-public-text.sh --hash NAME FLAGS WORD
# A hash of a common word can be guessed, so this keeps the names out of the
# file, not secret. Exceptions go in allowlist.txt, as for denylist.txt.
